people.imagined: Afternoon in the jacket shed. She has pulled off her mittens to show a new apprentice the right way to lift a copper jacket and is mid-argument with someone off frame about the Water roots at the furnace door. Her hands are the only thing she is proud of.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy packing shed she has just pulled her mittens off and holds both bare hands up at chest height, palms toward the viewer, as if to say look at these. Most important: the hands. Both hands and wrists are scarred a glossy pink in long burn stripes from hot copper, the scars clearly visible and large in the frame. Face: a square, determined face with a strong chin, skin tanned ruddy from the steam, thick straight brows drawn down in a scowl, hazel eyes bright and combative, a short broad nose, wide mouth set in a stubborn line, a small dent between the brows. Hair: dark brown, thick, twisted into one heavy knot at the nape and held by a plain bronze pin, loose strands stuck damp to her temples. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, leaning slightly forward. Clothing: a rust-brown felt robe with the sleeves pushed above the elbow, a thick seal-skin vest over it left open, the collar crossed and plain; two pairs of grey wool mittens stuffed into the front of her coat so their fingers hang out. Hands and objects: the scarred bare hands; behind them the edge of a bright copper jacket with water droplets on it. Background: a blurred shed of wooden racks hung with quilted copper jackets, white steam rising. Light: warm orange glow from a furnace low on the right, cool white daylight from the upper left on her face. Expression: scowling, argumentative, ready to talk over anyone; a faint hint of red heat in the air around the hands.

people.imagined: Dusk at the quay of the fire-jade boat. He has not spoken in an hour, and the cold pipe is in his mouth because he has run out of the leaf to light it. He is watching the crew row out and decides again not to be the first Water root through the furnace door.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a wooden quay he watches the viewer sidelong, an unlit pipe clamped in his teeth, completely unbothered. Face: a long, lean, sun-creased face the colour of old rope; the neck above the collar deeply creased in a criss-cross of lines; narrow grey-green eyes half-lidded, crow's feet fanning to the temples; a hooked nose; stubble the colour of salt and pepper along the jaw; the pipe, a short blackened wooden pipe with a bone stem, held between his teeth and tilted upward at the left. Fine salt crystals have dried in the hollows of his cheeks. Hair: dark and thinning, cropped short, a faded blue cloth band tied around the forehead. Body: lanky, loose-limbed, one shoulder dropped, leaning on something out of frame. Clothing: an oiled seal-skin jacket, dark glossy brown with a stand-up collar, over a rust-brown felt shirt with the collar open; a loop of rope over one shoulder. Hands and objects: one hand lifted to take the pipe out, the knuckles thick and scarred by rope, a coil of wet rope in the other. Background: blurred grey sea, a boat with a dark tarred sail low behind his shoulder, a faint orange glow of fire jade in the hull. Lanterns being lit along the quay throw soft amber discs on the water. Light: low amber dusk from the upper left, cold blue sky behind. Expression: a sleepy, amused, deliberately lazy calm with the pipe tilted in the grin; a faint blue-green hint of water qi in the damp air round the rope.

people.imagined: Night at the furnace mouth. She is stirring the broth pot with a ladle too big for her and has just stuffed a letter into the fire without reading it. The flames make her laugh.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a glowing furnace mouth, she is mid-laugh, one hand tossing a folded paper into the flames, the other holding a long ladle upright. Face: a round, open, freckled face with full cheeks pink from the heat; big dark brown eyes crinkled with laughter; a snub nose with a smear of soot on its tip; a wide mouth showing a small gap between her front teeth. Hair: black, in one lopsided thick braid over her left shoulder, tied at the end with a loop of kitchen twine, short wisps frizzing at her forehead. Body: sturdy and short, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: a rust-brown felt tunic with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a large cream linen apron over it splashed down the front with brown broth stains, the apron strings tied in a bow at the neck; a cord of twine round her wrist. Hands and objects: a big iron ladle held upright with steam rising from it, and a small folded paper (blank outside) at the edge of the fire. Background: a blurred iron pot the size of a barrel, orange furnace mouth, hanging copper pans. Light: strong orange firelight from the lower right, dim cool night behind. Expression: laughing, careless, a little defiant. A faint warm red hint of fire qi around the flames.

people.imagined: Furnace roster room, late. He holds a brush and a page he has copied perfectly, and looks up with a slow smile at a boy who has come in to ask a favour. He enjoys being looked at as a person who decides things.
people.subject: The moment: in a lamplit writing room he looks up from his work with a smile held a little too long, brush in hand. Most important: the smile and the burn. A narrow, handsome face, high cheekbones, a straight nose; a thick pale burn-line runs across the chin from the left jaw to the right, shiny and raised and clearly visible; thin dark eyebrows arched; heavy-lidded black eyes that do not blink; his thin mouth stretched into a smile that stays after it should have ended. Hair: black, glossy, tied high in a tight topknot with a strip of cinnabar-red cloth. Body: slim, upright, narrow shoulders squared. Clothing: a carefully pressed rust-red felt robe with a high collar buttoned to the throat, sleeves pushed back above the wrists to show forearms; a thin black cuff band on each sleeve. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a thin brush, the right thumb stained bright cinnabar red to the first joint; his left hand rests flat on a pale sheet of paper (blank) on a low desk. Background: dim wall of pigeonholes, one oil lamp. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, deep shadow on the right of his face. Expression: smiling, patient, cold. A very faint red-orange hint of fire qi in the lamp flame.

people.imagined: Midday on the fire-jade boat, ballast being shifted. She has just pocketed a chip of gold fire jade and is checking whether anyone saw, with a bright, innocent face.
people.subject: The moment: on a boat's deck in strong sun she glances to one side with an innocent, bright face while one hand is tucked casually at her collar. Face: a broad, tanned, freckled face with strong cheekbones; wide-set dark eyes quick and watchful; thick black brows; a small nose peeling from sunburn; full lips pressed together in a bright, too-sweet smile. Hair: black, chopped short with a knife just above the ears, spiky and salt-stiff, a thin braid at the nape. Body: powerful for her size: broad shoulders, thick forearms bare from the rolled sleeves. Clothing: an oiled seal-skin vest, glossy dark brown, over a short-sleeved rust-brown felt shirt; at the left collar a small chip of gold-yellow fire jade sewn into the cloth with red thread, glinting; a leather strap across the chest. Hands and objects: her right hand holds the end of a wooden oar planted like a staff, the left holds a rope. Background: blurred blue sea and a hull edge of grey planks, a faint gold glow in the bilge. Light: bright white sun from the upper left, sparkle on the water behind. Expression: innocent, eager, a flicker of cunning in the eyes. A faint blue hint of water qi in the spray at her sleeve.

people.imagined: Snow house, after midnight. He is rolling one die between his fingers while he owes everyone, and does not realise he is doing it. A man across the table has just said his name.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim snow house he turns his head toward someone off frame at the sound of his name, a small die rolling between the fingers of one hand. Face: a thin, quick, boyish face with a wide jaw; skin windburned to two red flushes high on the cheeks; large restless brown eyes with dark circles under them; a crooked, easy grin; a short stubble of light brown; one ear (the right) sticking out, the left covered. Hair: sandy brown, long on top and unkempt; a battered flat felt hat pulled down over his left ear and tilted. A few days of grime have darkened the roots. Body: wiry, slouched, one shoulder forward. Clothing: an oiled seal-skin coat unbuttoned over a rust-brown felt shirt, the collar of the shirt askew; a loose scarf of red wool around the neck; one cuff unbuttoned. Hands and objects: the fingers of his right hand roll a small bone die across the knuckles; his left hand rests on a wooden table scattered with a few small pebbles and a dented tin cup. Background: low snow-block wall, one hanging lamp, other gamblers as dark blurred shapes. A thin trail of breath-steam hangs at the low door, and a pile of boots lies stacked in the corner. Light: warm yellow lamplight from the upper left, cold blue at the edge. Expression: an easy, charming grin with a little hunted tension behind it, eyes flicking toward whoever said his name; a faint blue hint of water qi in the cup.

people.imagined: Brewing room at dawn. She hums while she stirs a small pot and tucks a strand of hair behind her ear without seeing the soot she leaves. She is worried about the quarrel but the tune does not know it.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn in a brewing room she looks down into a small pot she stirs, humming, her head slightly bowed so the birthmark shows. Face: a small, gentle, heart-shaped face with pale freckled skin; a small coal-coloured birthmark, dark grey-black and the size of a thumbnail, clearly visible on the left side of her neck above the collar; soft brown eyes lowered; thin straight brows slightly lifted in worry; a small mouth curved in a faint hum; one smudge of soot on the cheek. Hair: light chestnut brown, pinned up in a neat round coil with two wooden pins, short wisps escaping at the neck. Body: slight, shoulders narrow, elbows tucked in. Clothing: a rust-brown felt robe, plain and neatly pressed, sleeves tied back with cloth cords; a small grey linen apron; around her neck a thin cord with a small wooden spoon-shaped charm. Hands and objects: a long wooden paddle in her right hand dipping into a small copper pot; her left hand cups a clay cup. Background: shelves of small clay jars, a window with the first pink light. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left, warm glow from the pot below. Expression: absorbed, soft, worried underneath. A faint warm red hint of fire qi rising with the steam.

people.imagined: The council hall at night, the one hour he is alone. He warms his hands on the censer and thinks of the year he gave nine years of snow to the fire. He speaks to the coal as to an old friend.
people.subject: The moment: seated alone at night, he holds both palms out over a small bronze censer on his knee as if warming them, and looks at the viewer over it. Most important: the glazed skin and the bare brow. A broad, round, short-necked old face whose skin looks glazed and shiny like old burned clay, pink-brown and smooth in places; no eyebrows at all, only smooth skin above the eyes; deep-set small dark eyes with the red of coals in them; heavy cheeks, a wide flat nose, a wide thin mouth, a slow small smile; deep lines at the mouth. Hair: a thin ring of white hair above the ears, the crown bald and ruddy. Body: short, broad and thick through the chest, shoulders rounded with age. His hands are heavy and square, and his shoulders slope beneath the felt. Clothing: a heavy robe of dark red-brown felt, the collar edged with a thick band of white seal fur; over it a short sleeveless coat of black wool; plain bronze toggles; a black iron ring, thick and blackened, on his left ring finger. Hands and objects: a bronze censer the size of two fists on his lap with a coal glowing at its mouth; his hands, glazed like his face, held over it. Background: a dark hall, a wall of faint red from a furnace beyond. A faint red glimmer on a tall brass lamp-stand and the dark shapes of carved benches fill the hall. Light: red-orange from the coal rising on to his chin and the underside of his face, cool grey from the upper left. Expression: a patient, warm, slyly amused look with the small slow smile, an old man speaking fondly to a coal; a deep red-orange hint of fire qi in the coal glow.

people.imagined: A winter morning in the jacket hall; she has just lifted the first snow jacket from its stand and checked its weight against her wrist. She never raises her voice, and now she is quietly listening to someone shout.
people.subject: The moment: in the jacket hall she stands very tall and still, one hand lifting a quilted silk jacket from its stand, her head tilted as she listens to someone shouting. Face: a long, serene, pale face with high cheekbones and a long straight nose; frost-white rime on the lashes and the hem of her sleeves; calm grey eyes, steady; thin brows; thin lips, closed; a faint soot smudge on the right cheekbone; fine lines at the eye corners. Hair: black streaked with one broad white streak from the left temple, gathered into a low knot at the nape held by a narrow copper pin. Body: tall, straight-backed, long neck, wide shoulders. Clothing: a long seal-skin coat, dark and glossy, worn over red-brown felt; wide sleeves lightly frosted at the cuffs; a collar of grey fur; below the coat the pale edge of a white linen inner robe. Hands and objects: her soot-blackened right hand lifts the First Snow Jacket, a quilted silk jacket in pale grey-blue with water faintly moving between its layers; in the other hand she holds a black calabash gourd banded in copper, small as a pear. Background: a row of identical quilted jackets on wooden stands in white steam. Light: cold white window light from the upper left, a warm orange line from a furnace at the far right. Expression: composed, listening, unhurried. A subtle balance of faint red heat and pale blue chill in the air.

people.imagined: Training yard at noon. He has dyed a new robe the night before and is wearing it before the old men, wanting them all to see. He stands with his forearms bare and the scorch marks proud.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bare winter yard at noon, arms crossed and chin up, wanting to be seen. Most important: the robe: a robe of vivid cinnabar red, far brighter and redder than anyone else's rust-brown, fills the lower frame. A lean, sharp, young face with high cheekbones; a pointed chin; narrow black eyes under straight sharp brows; a thin, hawkish nose; a faint smirk on thin lips; a clean-shaved jaw. Hair: black, combed back smooth and tied high in a tight topknot with a lacquer-red band; a single lock hangs loose at the left. Body: lean, wiry, broad at the shoulder; forearms bare and scorched in many small dark burn-marks. Clothing: a hand-dyed cinnabar-red felt robe, almost garish, the collar crossed and stiff, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a black belt of braided leather; underneath, a black linen shirt. Hands and objects: arms crossed; in the right hand a small, shallow iron dish of glowing coals held balanced on the forearm. Background: a blurred snowy yard, grey felt-clad men in two rows, pale sky. Light: flat bright winter light from the upper left, sharp shadows. Expression: proud, impatient, ambitious. A strong hot red hint of fire qi shimmering above his shoulders.

people.imagined: An herb shed at dusk. She is counting the satchels on their pegs by touch and finds one missing; her mouth goes tight. The green of the satchel is the only green she has.
people.subject: The moment: in a dusky herb shed she stands with her hand flat on a green satchel across her chest, as though holding it shut, her head tilted. Most important: the green satchel. A bright forest-green leather satchel with a brass buckle, as wide as her torso, crossing her chest from the right shoulder to the left hip, the one green thing in the picture. A small, round, grey, wrinkled woman's face; round cheeks; a small nose; faded blue-grey eyes sharp as a hawk's; thin grey brows; thin lips pressed shut; a faint downturn at the corners of her mouth. Hair: grey and fine, parted in the middle and pinned in a tight bun at the back with a bone pin. Body: very small and slightly stooped, but firm. Clothing: a plain rust-brown felt robe, high-collared, neat; a grey wool shawl over the shoulders; sleeves narrow with cloth cuffs; small black felt boots (out of frame). Hands and objects: a work-hardened hand on the satchel flap; in the other hand a small bundle of dry mugwort tied with red thread. Background: wooden pegs with other, empty hooks, hanging bundles of dried herbs, the dusk window. Light: dim blue dusk from the upper left, a thin warm lamp glow below. Expression: severe, watchful, grieving under it. A faint green hint of wood qi in the herb bundle.

people.imagined: The quay at dawn after a night at sea. He is looking at the horizon past the reef where his great-grandfather's boat lies, and the harpoon on his back is heavier than usual. Someone has asked a question and he does not hear it.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stone quay he is a huge figure looking out to sea, his back half-turned, the harpoon showing over his shoulder. Face: a huge, weathered face as wide as a shield; heavy brow ridges; small deep-set grey eyes narrowed against the glare; a thick nose broken once; salt crystals white in a thick, tangled, brown-grey beard that reaches the chest; deep wind lines at the eyes. Hair: brown and grey, long and thick, tied back in a short tail with leather. Body: enormous: wide neck, shoulders as broad as a door, thick arms. Clothing: oiled seal-skin coat, glossy black-brown, hooded with the hood down, the collar stiff with salt; underneath, red-brown felt; leather straps crossing the chest. Hands and objects: across his back a harpoon of pale spirit-whale rib with an iron head and a coil of sea-silk line, the head rising behind his right shoulder; one hand rests on the shaft. Background: grey-pink dawn, blurred reef, a dark wreck-shape in the surf. Light: low pink-gold from the upper left on the left of his beard, the rest in cold shadow. Expression: stubborn, brooding, far away. A faint blue-green hint of sea qi in the mist.

people.imagined: Night watch at the red furnace. He is sitting by the vent with a pouch in his lap, counting jade pieces with a thumb, and has not hurried in a hundred years. A sound makes him look up slowly.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a stool by a vent in the night, his thumb moving over a small pouch in his lap, he lifts his eyes slowly. Most important: the singed queue. A long grey queue of hair over his shoulder, burned short and uneven at the end so it looks singed like a fuse. A long, thin, hollow-cheeked old face; skin tallow-yellow; heavy eyelids; small pale eyes; a long nose; thin colourless lips; a grey sparse moustache; deep creases down from the nose. Hair: grey, scraped back tight from the forehead into the queue, the temples bald. The singed tip of the queue is darker than the rest and curls where the fire took it. Body: tall, thin and slightly bent, very still. Clothing: a rust-brown felt robe, old but spotless and heavy; a wide black belt; a dark wool cloak over the shoulders; felt cuffs closed. The felt robe is brushed, the collar neatly turned, and the cloak is clasped with a plain brass pin. Hands and objects: a small leather pouch in his lap, one thumb pressing a pea-sized gold-yellow stone half out of it; a lantern with a red glass beside his knee. Background: dark, the faint red glow of a furnace vent behind a stone arch, a heavy wooden door. Light: red-orange glow from the vent on the lower left of his face, cold blue moonlight from the upper left. Expression: an unhurried, patient, quietly greedy stillness, the pale eyes rising slowly from the pouch; a faint trace of fire qi lies on the gold-yellow stone.

people.imagined: Kitchen morning, dumplings by the hundred. He holds a letter, once, and it is the only thing he ever re-reads. He hides it in the flour bin and laughs at the face he has made.
people.subject: The moment: in a kitchen at morning he pats a dumpling and laughs, flour in the air, one floury hand tucking a folded paper under his apron bib. A round, lumpy, uneven face like a poorly-pinched dumpling: cheeks sagging in folds, a double chin, a soft potato nose with a dent in the side, small cheerful black eyes buried in creases; thick white flour dusted across the eyebrows so they look like snow; a big, toothy grin. Hair: thin black hair going grey, a small knot on top tied with a cloth strip, dusted with flour. A fleck of dough clings to one white eyebrow. Body: very stout, round shoulders, a big belly. Clothing: a rust-brown felt tunic, sleeves rolled to the elbows over thick forearms; a huge cream-coloured apron smeared with flour and bean paste; a flat cloth cap hanging off the back of his head. Hands and objects: a floury right hand pressing the top of a pale round dumpling; a wooden rolling-pin tucked under his left arm; a corner of folded paper visible. The paper corner is soft and pale, folded small, and dusted with flour. Background: a steaming bamboo stack, a wall of copper pots, a stove with orange coals. Light: warm yellow from a window at the upper left, steam glowing. Expression: a jolly, generous, toothy grin with creased cheeks, and a hidden ache behind the eyes; a faint warm red hint of fire qi in the stove glow.

people.imagined: The second ash boat in a fresh wind. She has rowed past the point where her father begged her to turn, and a spray of salt has bleached her fringe white. She does not look back.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the stern of a boat in wind, she looks straight ahead and ignores a voice from behind, a hand held up to shield her eyes. Face: a long, narrow, tanned face with a strong jaw; hard dark-brown eyes with a cold steadiness; straight black brows; a high-bridged nose; a mouth set in a hard line; a faint scar at the corner of the lip. Salt has dried in white lines at her temples and her lips are cracked. Hair: black bleached nearly white by salt at the tips, hacked short with a knife at jaw level in uneven lengths, blown sideways by the wind. Body: lean and strong, shoulders wide, standing very straight. Clothing: oiled seal-skin jacket sleeveless over a short-sleeved rust-brown felt shirt, a thick leather cuff on the left wrist; a belt of knotted sea-silk. Hands and objects: her right palm, calloused and scarred from harpoon shafts, lifted open in front of her brow; her left hand grips an oar. Background: white-capped grey sea, a second oar and prow, a smudge of a dark headland at the horizon. Dark water slaps against the hull and one gull wheels high above the headland. Light: sharp white sea light from the upper left, cold. Expression: a cold, intent, ambitious stare straight ahead, deaf to every voice behind her; a faint blue-white hint of water qi in the spray.

people.imagined: Snow-shovel yard at dusk. His face is black to the eyes with soot-snow; he answers a moment late and does not mind. He believes the fire will grow if he stands close.
people.subject: The moment: in a snowy yard he stands holding a shovel and looks at the viewer with a smile a moment slow to arrive. Most important: the black face. A wide, willing young face blackened from the forehead to the lower lip with soot and snow-water in a thick grey-black mask, with a clean pink band around the mouth and chin; large round brown eyes very white in the black; short unplucked brows; a short wide nose; a gap-toothed grin. Hair: black, a shock of straight stiff hair sticking out under a grey knit cap pulled down to the brows. Soot has turned the tips of his hair black as well. Body: gangly, thin shoulders, long arms, a little hunched. Clothing: a rust-brown felt tunic one size too big, sleeves rolled twice; a short seal-skin vest; a fisher's rope belt; the cuffs black with soot. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long wooden shovel upright, its blade packed with snow, thick fisherman's mittens, one with a hole at the thumb. Background: a snow bank, a copper jacket rack, steam, the dusk sky. Piles of grey ash and snow rise beside a low, red-lit furnace door. Light: cold blue evening light from the upper left, orange from the furnace low right. Expression: a trusting, eager, slightly slow smile arriving a moment late over the black mask; a very faint red heat shimmer near his hands.

people.imagined: The brewing hall just after a batch is done. She stands with the cooling paddle like a staff, and her sleeves are spotless because she has been careful all day. Someone is being blamed in the next room and she says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: in the brewing hall she stands straight with a tall cooling paddle held upright beside her like a staff, her sleeves spotless, looking mildly at the viewer. A long cooling paddle of pale wood taller than her head, with a flat spatula end, stands upright in her left hand; her wide sleeves are a perfect unstained rust-brown felt with a crisp white cuff, with not a speck of soot. Face: an oval, composed, pale-rose face with smooth skin; level hazel eyes; thin, neat, arched brows; a small straight nose; closed lips with the faintest curl; a mole under the left eye. Hair: black with a faint auburn gloss, parted centrally and coiled into a smooth bun low at the nape, two plain pins. Body: slender, very upright, shoulders square. She stands with her weight even on both feet. Clothing: a rust-brown felt robe with crossed collar, perfectly pressed; a dove-grey sash; a fine white inner collar. Hands and objects: the paddle, and in the right hand a small white porcelain dish of a pale amber pill. Background: a bright clean brewing hall with rows of covered pots in soft steam. Cooling trays gleam with tidy rows of amber pills and the shadow of a ladle hangs on the wall. Light: even soft white light from the upper left. Expression: a serene, pleasant, closed calm with the faintest curl at the lips, a woman who says nothing while someone else is blamed; a faint balance of red and pale blue qi in the steam.

people.imagined: A hillside in the cape forest at first light. He has found a rare plant, glances left and right and tucks it in his tin before anyone can see. Pollen is in his hair.
people.subject: The moment: crouched in a forest clearing at dawn he looks sideways over his shoulder, hand closing a small tin lid. Most important: the pollen in his hair. Bright yellow pollen dusts his dark hair and shoulders in a visible golden cloud. A narrow, wary, pale face; long nose; light hazel eyes darting to one side; thin brows; thin lips pressed together; a patchy stubble on the chin. Hair: dark brown, floppy, falling in front of one eye, the pollen caught in it. A fleck of yellow pollen sits on one eyelash. Body: lean, hunched, crouching, knees up. Clothing: a rust-brown felt robe with the hem tucked into the belt and stained green at the knees; a green leather satchel across the chest with a brass buckle, smaller than his teacher's; a grey wool scarf; leaf fragments clinging to his sleeves. Hands and objects: in his right hand a small flat tin with a lid half closed over some pale-green leaves; in his left a short curved gathering knife. His thumb is stained green from the stems and the tin's lid is dented at the corner. Background: blurred ferns and pine trunks, a thin golden mist. Light: soft gold dawn light from the upper left through branches. Expression: a secretive, watchful, covetous look with the eyes slid sideways and the lips pressed; a faint green hint of wood qi on the leaves.

people.imagined: The night in 929 when she knew the island coal was dying. A memorial portrait: the founder with her coal-box held to her hip, brows singed, looking toward the vent she is about to enter.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; she stands calm and tall with a small coal-box at her hip. Face: a long, strong, bony face; high cheekbones; straight singed brows, shortened and uneven, scorched to almost nothing at the outer ends; steady dark eyes; a firm mouth; a faint smile of resolve; lines of weather at the eyes. Hair: black with grey threads, pulled tight into a high knot, a short singed fringe over the forehead. The singed ends curl slightly where the flame took them. Body: tall and straight-backed, broad through the shoulder, with long strong hands, the frame of a woman who carried coal. Clothing: an old-fashioned long robe of red-brown felt, the collar crossed, high and plain; a sleeveless coat of thick dark seal-skin; a wide leather belt. Hands and objects: a small coal-box of pale green jade, lidded, hanging by a cord and held against her right hip with her right hand; her left hand open and relaxed. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a faint rising orange glow low behind her. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, soot-dark vignette at the edges. The faded silk tone turns the felt a dusty rust and the jade a pale grey-green. Expression: a calm, unafraid, resolved look with a faint smile, the eyes already on the vent; a faint red-orange hint of fire qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 884, the whale road. A memorial portrait of the giant at the bow of his hunter's skiff with the white-streaked beard blown across his chest and the scar across his shoulder bare, looking at the sea that took him.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; he stands in a boat's bow, giant and bare-shouldered, looking out. A broad rope-like scar runs diagonally across the right bare shoulder and upper chest, pale and raised, clearly visible; a thick black beard streaked in two broad white stripes from the chin to the chest. A huge, square, weathered face; heavy brow; small fierce dark eyes narrowed at the horizon; a hooked nose; a wide mouth set in arrogant calm; deep seams at the eyes. Hair: black and thick, shoulder-length, blown back by the wind, a braid in the front. Two grey strands cross his brow and the wind tugs the braid. Body: a giant, broad chest and thick arms, barrel torso. Clothing: a sleeveless vest of sealskin, open at the front, leaving the right shoulder bare; heavy trousers of oiled hide; a belt of braided sea-silk; a bone clasp. Hands and objects: a long whale-rib harpoon with an iron head lifted over the right shoulder, one fist closed round the shaft; a coiled line at his feet. Background: pale faded grey-blue sea and sky as on old silk, a smear of white spray. The faded ground shows a pale line of waves and the shape of a headland like a thumbprint of ink. Light: cold sea light from the upper left, yellowed. Expression: an arrogant, stubborn, fearless calm, the eyes narrowed on the sea that took him; a faint blue hint of water qi in the spray.

people.imagined: 1098, the last day before seclusion. A memorial portrait of the tiny severe healer, long braid unfinished down her back, in satchel green, her hands folded on a closed satchel as she steps toward the closed door.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a tiny, severe woman standing facing the viewer, hands folded. Most important: the unfinished braid and the green. A very long single braid of grey-black hair hangs forward over her left shoulder to her waist, the last hand's-breadth unbraided in loose strands; her whole robe is a deep forest green, the one strong colour. A small, narrow, severe face; high flat cheekbones; thin dark brows drawn together; sharp black eyes; a small thin nose; a thin lipless mouth; fine lines everywhere; pale skin. Hair: grey-black, parted at the side and drawn smoothly back from a high pale brow. Body: tiny, very upright. Clothing: a long robe of green silk with plain wide sleeves, the collar high and crossed, a narrow dark-green sash, a short sleeveless jacket in dull green over it; a green cloth wrapped satchel hanging at her right side. Hands and objects: her small hands folded together in front over a closed, dark green leather satchel with a brass buckle. Her knuckles are small and bony, with a faint tinge of herb-green in the nails. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with the faint shapes of hanging herb bundles. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, dark vignette. The silk fade turns the greens to a deep olive, the one strong colour in a ground of cream and ash. Expression: a severe, resolute, unyielding calm, the sharp eyes on the closed door; a faint green hint of wood qi, softened by the fade.
